summary: Validated P0 fix for Search War Room 520 errors. All 9 backend tests passed. POST /api/web-intel/war-room now completes in 10.39-12.76s (was ~19s), well under the 15s Cloudflare hard limit. Payload shape (brief/engine_results/warnings), AI analysis engine result, provider registry timeout caps, cache status, and phase-cap behavior on unresolvable tickers all verified.

minor.issue: MSFT earnings query hit 12.76s — marginally above the 12s soft target though comfortably under the 15s hard limit. Occasional variance likely comes from AI_ANALYSIS_TIMEOUT bumping against its 5s cap on slow LLM turns. If prod jitter pushes closer to 15s consider dropping AI_ANALYSIS_TIMEOUT to 4s or PROVIDER_PHASE_TIMEOUT to 5.0s to give AI more slack; currently non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: orchestrator.py line 105: `except (asyncio.TimeoutError, Exception)` is redundant — Exception already covers TimeoutError. Cosmetic, not a bug.

orchestrator.py line 64 `asyncio.gather(..., return_exceptions=False)` — since `_run_provider` wraps every exception into an EngineResult, this can never raise from a task. Safe today, but a future refactor that removes the internal try/except would silently break the phase cap. Consider `return_exceptions=True` for defense-in-depth.

orchestrator.py line 69-83 partial-collection path cancels pending tasks but does not `await` the cancellation — usually fine but under load can leave brief background CancelledError logs. Awaiting `asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)` after cancel would silence them.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file /app/backend/tests/test_war_room_p0_timing.py is a regression suite for the P0 War Room timing fix. Contains: (1) status endpoint provider timeout caps, (2) cache/status 200 check, (3) 5 parameterized war-room queries (TSLA/AAPL/MSFT/GOOGL/Fed) — assert <15s and valid payload shape, (4) AI analysis engine ok check, (5) phase-cap hang guard on nonexistent ticker. Uses conftest_creds for BASE_URL and admin login (httpOnly cookie + Bearer belt-and-suspenders). Total run ~80s. Observed timings this iteration: 10.39-12.76s.
rca of the issue: Prod 520 error root cause: AI_ANALYSIS_TIMEOUT=18s plus unbounded parallel provider phase (individual providers up to 15s) produced ~19s total wall-clock, exceeding Cloudflare/ingress ~15s timeout. Fix applied by main agent: (a) AI_ANALYSIS_TIMEOUT 18→5s, (b) new PROVIDER_PHASE_TIMEOUT=5.5s wrapping asyncio.gather with partial-collection on timeout, (c) individual provider timeouts capped 4-6s (was 10-15s), (d) ai_analysis max_tokens 600→400. Total worst-case now ~11s (5.5 + 5 + overhead). Validated: all queries returned in 10.4-12.8s with valid payloads; degraded flag correctly set to True for nonexistent tickers (pre-existing behavior, not a regression).
